annotations.title: Ver produtos e SKUs da empresa

description: What a Brazilian company sells and how much of it: products registered at the Anvisa across its economic group (registered foods such as supplements, and cleaning products) and the product pages of its own site (pass domain), the product kinds with their usual packaging, and a volume tier (alto, médio, baixo) with why. Free. Answers how many SKUs or products a company has, what kinds, or tiers brand owners by volume. The open data leaves out notified cosmetics, beverages and meat; then, without a site sitemap, the count is partial and the result says so instead of guessing a tier.

cnpj.description: The company's CNPJ, with or without punctuation.

domain.description: The company's site, e.g. ype.com.br, to count its product pages.
